title: After the Storm

readiness.math: equal spacing with a measuring stick; counting nails
readiness.reading: pre-reader friendly; all text can be read aloud

intro.speaker: ruth
intro.text: What a storm last night! The wind blew part of the sheepfold fence right down.

intro.speaker: ruth
intro.text: Mr. Amos's hand is better now. He's cut the posts. Let's space them with the stick, then nail on the rails.

steps.speaker: ruth
steps.prompt: Put a post one stick away from the stone. Then one stick away from that post, and so on.
steps.hint: Lay the stick next to the stone. Where does the other end reach? Put a post there.

feedback.placed_all: Now let's check with the stick.
feedback.crowded: The stick covers a post there. Can it move further away?
feedback.far: There's a gap past the end of the stick. Can that post move closer?
feedback.all_good: Every space is one stick long. A good straight fence!

steps.speaker: ruth
steps.prompt: Now two nails in each post, to hold the rails. Count: one, two.
steps.hint: Find a post with an empty dip and put a nail there.

older.prompt: Three nails in each post this time. No dips: count them yourself.

feedback.full: That post has its nails. Try another.

outro.speaker: ruth
outro.text: Oh dear, look: the gate swung open in the night. One of my lambs is missing!

outro.speaker: ruth
outro.text: We'll look for her tomorrow, at first light. Don't worry. A good shepherd never stops looking.

journal_line: After the storm, I helped mend the sheepfold fence.
